settings.the_text: Tribe Organics is proud to support active duty military, veterans, and members’ families.

Tribe Organics offers a special discount for those who are in active duty, veterans who served as a member of the United States military, retirees, and military immediate family. Thankful for your service, we are pleased to offer 20% off all eligible Tribe Organics products.*

Please contact us directly at info@tribe-organics.com to provide proof of your service (either a scanned copy of your VA card, State-issued ID showing your Veteran status or a recent Military pay stub) and receive your discount code.

Please note: This discount does not stack with other promotional offers and discounts. Discounts are not applicable to subscription products or multi packs.
